action.question: How do you want to make Maven use JDK 21 by default?

questions.question: How do you want to make Maven use JDK 21 by default?

options.label: Global default (~/.zshrc)
options.description: Add `export JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)` to ~/.zshrc. mvn AND all Java in your shells default to 21; override per-command for 26. Simplest, since dstrader is your only Java project. (Recommended)

options.label: Maven-only (~/.mavenrc)
options.description: Put the same export in ~/.mavenrc — only Maven uses 21; your shell's default `java` stays 26 for everything else.

options.label: In-repo enforcement (toolchains)
options.description: Add maven-toolchains-plugin to the pom + a per-machine ~/.m2/toolchains.xml pinning JDK 21. Build is locked to 21 for every builder/CI, fails loudly if 21 is missing. Most reproducible, but a hard requirement + pom change.

`mvn` itself is fine — the problem is purely the **JDK it defaults to**. Homebrew's `maven` depends on the unversioned `openjdk` (26), and its `mvn` shim points `JAVA_HOME` there when you haven't set one. So "correcting it" = making Maven use JDK 21. Let me confirm exactly how the shim picks Java so I give you the right lever:
First, confirming your "done": let me verify the toolchain is gone, and check your shell profile so I propose the right edit.

Toolchain removed ✓, and `JAVA_HOME` isn't set anywhere — which is the whole cause. There's nothing to *reinstall*: your brew `mvn` is fine. The shim is literally:

```
JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/.../Home}" exec .../mvn "$@"
```

So when `JAVA_HOME` is unset it falls back to brew's **openjdk 26** → the Lombok crash. The fix is just to point `JAVA_HOME` at 21. Three ways, with different blast radius:
